name: Kokuhaku
source:
Three high school girls confess their problems to the main character who works as a counselor. He will need to find the right approach to each of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三名高中女生向担任心理咨询师的主人公倾诉各自的烦恼。他需要找到适合每个人的应对方式。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
